ab_test.rule: after 10 trading days: adopt market-on-open if its cost is >= 0.10 points lower and >= 95% of its shares filled; otherwise keep market orders

official_line.note: official = bought at the official close, sold at the next official open (the auction prices live market-on-close/open orders get), before commissions and fees; paper = Alpaca paper's simulated fills

summary.note: paper fills are simulated: this checks the mechanics, not real auction costs. Sales are netted with desk trades in the same stock, so their fill price is the whole order's
